claims.text: Allergic rhinitis with uncontrolled moderate–severe persistent asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps: omalizumab (anti-IgE) and dupilumab (anti-IL-4/IL-13) improve both upper airway symptoms and asthma
claims.quote: Some medications may be particularly helpful when allergic rhinitis coexists with uncontrolled moderate to severe persistent asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps. Omalizumab, a monoclonal antibody directed against IgE, and dupilumab, a monoclonal antibody directed against IL-4/IL-13, have demonstrated improvement in both upper airway symptoms and asthma
